responsibility: Implements the source-like pretty printer for GCC tree IR. It formats declarations, expressions, statements, operators, calls, strings, and function headers into C-like text for diagnostics and dumps, handles identifier translation and sanitization, provides debugging entry points, and is distinct from the structural tree dumper because it emphasizes human-readable language-style rendering rather than raw node topology.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual tree pretty-printing implementation that renders declarations, expressions, statements, call names, strings, and function headers into human-readable output for dumps and debugging. Unlike gcc/tree-pretty-print.h, which only declares the printing entry points and helper macros, this file performs the formatting.
